name: Corrective Action

description.content: When the trial starts, you earn [3] Tokens, up to [5].
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn [1] Token.
Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend [1] Token:

items: The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check.
You see that Survivor's Aura for [6s].

quote: "Can't hurt to have another set of eyes on the problem." -Jonah Vasquez
